I was booked with her in September last year for unbearable period cramps that I had never experienced before in the last 20+ years that I menstruate. I told her that this has been happening for 3 months and the pain is so bad that I throw up nearly every time and almost pass out; that I (still) take so much ibuprofen that I can probably get medication poisoning but I get so numb from the pain that if I don’t, I feel I’ll die.
Anyway, having explained the above to her, I asked for an US scan to see what’s going as I’ve got a history of cysts - which I saw that she did not document in her consultation notes. She plain refused to refer me and told me she’s seen no grounds for referral and I can’t get an US scan when this is just the first time it’s happened. I reiterated that’s it was my 3rd period with so much pain but I was told that since this was the first time I’d seen a GP for this reason, she could only prescribe strong painkillers to cope with the pain. This is not what I asked for (I never even collected the meds from the pharmacy) and I told her that I didn’t want to just mask the symptoms and wanted to see what’s going on as this is not normal for me. She sent me home still feeling debilitated from the pain that hadn’t fully passed - it’s worth noting that I was so pale from what had been through since that morning that I got scared when saw myself in the mirror when I got home. Not sure how she felt no concern - even as a fellow human.

Thank goodness for Dr Priyanka and Dr Musrat who have been incredibly understanding and never refusing investigations. Dr Priyanka insisted that I see a gynaecologist when the US scan showed no tangible abnormalities and when I finally saw a gynaecologist he told me that I have a fibroid that’s pressing on my womb and is causing contraction-like pain, which would explain my symptoms. I’m now scheduled for further tests before a surgery can be scheduled.
All admin staff are also incredibly helpful, which is the reason I’m leaving a 3* review rather than 1 - which this particular Dr absolutely
